gorseller.istem: Extreme close-up slow-motion at night in heavy rain: a huge crystal-clear raindrop, about three times the size of the mosquito's body, has just hit a realistic Culex mosquito (small slender grey-brown body with pale bands on the abdomen, a long thin needle-like proboscis pointing forward from the head, exactly six very thin long legs, two narrow transparent wings with fine veins, small dark compound eyes) in mid-air; the mosquito clings to the side of the glass-clear drop and is carried down with it, unharmed, rim light, dark blue stormy background with bright rain streaks. The animal's face sits in the upper middle part of the frame, with calm empty space in the lower third.
gorseller.not: Sivrisinek: ince uzun 6 bacak, iki şeffaf kanat, öne uzanan ince hortum. Damla sivrisineğin gövdesinden yaklaşık üç kat büyük, saydam. Sivrisinek ezilmemiş, bütün.
